contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DIVA FAVSTINA ; R/ AVGV STA

Silver coin. Commemorative denarius of Faustina I (138-161), as kindly suggested by the finder, mint of Rome, Juno seated right, RIC vol. 3 no 363, issue of 141-161 - the finder suggests of 148-161; Reece period 7. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with tighly curled and piled hairdo, draped, right. Obverse inscription: DIVA FAVSTINA. Reverse description: Juno seated right, with diagonal sceptre.…
